newsitem.title: USA: Dial to sell brands to Church & Dwight.
newsitem.headline: Dial to sell brands to Church & Dwight.

text.p: The Dial Corp said Thursday it agreed to sell certain household cleaning brands to Church & Dwight Co Inc, for about $30 million.
It said it will use proceeds of the sale to pay off debt.
Dial said the sale price was less than the value of the products, which generate annual sales of about $50 million. But it said the sale was part of its strategy to divest non-core operations.

The brands it agreed to sell, pending government approval, are: Brillo soap pads and related products, Parsons ammonia, Bo Peep ammonio, Sno Bol toilet bowl cleaner, Cameo metal cleaner and Rain Drops water softener. Dial's London, Ohio plant, where Billio products are made, will also be included in the sale.
Separately, Dial said it sold its Bruce floor care product trademarks to Triangle Pacific Corp of Dallas.
